limitations: Decision-only native tool selection; production tools are not executed.
Historical dev-v2 gold includes 11/24 cases adjudicated after model outputs; dev is not independent held-out evidence.
The added split is authored and reviewed, not a representative random SOC population sample.
Wilson intervals describe binomial uncertainty under independence assumptions; overlapping families/templates limit population claims.
Reviewer identities are reproduced from the existing lock; the runner does not certify either as human.
Dev and generalization denominators remain separate; missing cases are not discarded.

function.description:
Enrich an Indicator of Compromise (IOC) with Cyber Threat Intelligence.

Use this tool to get threat intelligence about:
- IPv4 addresses
- Domain names
- File hashes (MD5, SHA1, SHA256)

The tool returns:
- Reputation (benign/suspicious/malicious/unknown)
- Related threat actors (if known)
- Related malware families (if known)
- MITRE ATT&CK techniques
- Source attribution

Note: Do not call this tool for endpoint hostname or process context.
function.name: cti_enrichment

indicator.description: The IOC value to investigate (IP, domain, or hash)

indicator_type.description: The type of IOC. Auto-detected if not provided.

function.description:
Investigate flow telemetry for an IPv4 address.

Use this tool to analyze:
- Connection frequency and patterns
- Unique destinations and ports contacted
- Failed vs successful connection ratios
- Periodicity candidates (beaconing patterns)
- Scan candidates (port scanning patterns)
- Transfer metrics (large data transfers)
- Service fanout (admin service reachability)

This tool analyzes IP-based network logs and IDS/firewall telemetry.
Domain-only lookup is unavailable with current flow telemetry; obtain a
concrete IPv4 address before calling this tool.
When a frozen DuckDB snapshot is configured, the tool uses its internal,
read-only domain query layer. Do not send SQL in this tool call.
function.name: network_investigation

indicator.description: IPv4 address to investigate; domain-only lookup is unavailable

indicator_type.description: IPv4 or null for automatic IPv4 validation; domains are unsupported.

time_range.description: Optional time range for the investigation. Defaults to last 24 hours.

function.description:
Investigate endpoint telemetry for suspicious process relationships.

Use this tool to analyze:
- Parent-child process chains
- Suspicious application spawning (e.g., Word spawning PowerShell)
- LOLBin usage patterns
- MITRE ATT&CK technique indicators

This tool analyzes endpoint detection and response (EDR) data.
When a frozen DuckDB snapshot is configured, the tool uses its internal,
read-only domain query layer. Do not send SQL in this tool call.
Call this when process relationships are relevant to the investigation.
function.name: endpoint_investigation

host.description: The hostname or identifier of the endpoint to investigate

time_range.description: Optional time range for the investigation. Defaults to last 24 hours.
